name: release-workflow
description: The agent designs a reusable release process as a harness workflow (tests, a version from Conventional Commits, changelog, a person's approval, commit and tag) and then runs it. Judged on the workflow graph, the release it made, and the run record showing the approval step.
prompt: Make a reusable release process for this repository as a harness workflow in .harness/workflows/release.json, then use it to make the release. The workflow must: run the tests and end as failed if they fail; work out the next version from the commits since the latest tag by the Conventional Commits rules (a breaking change, "!" or BREAKING CHANGE, is major; feat is minor; fix is patch; nothing releasable means no release); set that version in package.json and add a section for it at the top of CHANGELOG.md with the changes grouped under Features and Fixes; ask a person to approve the release before anything is committed; on approval commit everything as "chore(release): vX.Y.Z" and create the annotated tag vX.Y.Z; on rejection leave the repository as it was. Then run your workflow to release this repository.

checks.name: the workflow is a valid graph with the steps asked for
the workflow ran, through its approval
